name: Flaky Test Debugging
summary: Diagnose nondeterministic tests caused by ordering, time, randomness, shared state, or external dependencies.
applies_when: A test passes and fails across runs or environments without an intended code change.

positive: This test fails intermittently in CI; find the source of flakiness
这个测试在 CI 中偶发失败，请定位原因
negative: Add unit tests for the parser edge cases
This pytest always fails with the same assertion
为解析器新增单元测试
hard_negative: pytest is failing with a traceback after my change
Add integration tests for the API and database transaction

contrastive.query: pytest is failing with a traceback after my change
contrastive.reason: A deterministic test failure uses the standard test-debug workflow.

contrastive.query: Add unit tests for the parser edge cases
contrastive.reason: Writing new tests is test generation.

contrastive.query: Find the race condition causing duplicate writes
contrastive.reason: Concurrency defects in product code are not test flakiness.
